title: Inventory with shrinkage, restock, and target margin
text: A store starts with 255 units costing 22.43 each. Each day for 12 days it sells 1 units at price 54.35; unsold inventory shrinks by 8% daily. Then it restocks 436 units at cost 11.45 and changes selling price to p2 for 11 days, selling 31 units per day (cannot exceed inventory). Given the total profit margin over the whole period is 2.8955% relative to total cost, find p2.
